lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are arranged in a semi-regular matrix of horizontal rows and vertical columns across the lateral flank, posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Prominent vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs in the posterior-most visible region of the flank, forming a grid-like lattice of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp transition from a high-luminance dorsal edge to a shadowed ventral margin.

other_distinctive_markers: An elongated, high-luminance biological attachment (remora) is visible on the lateral flank posterior to the fifth gill slit; a second remora is visible in the lower foreground beneath the ventral surface.
